title: FAQ 架構基礎 — Prisma 模型 + 管理端 API
content:
Phase 2 的 FAQ 系統需要資料庫模型與管理端 CRUD API。

Prisma 模型：
- FAQCategory: id, nameZh, nameEn, nameZhCn, order, createdAt, updatedAt
- FAQ: id, categoryId (FK → FAQCategory), questionZh, questionEn, questionZhCn, answerZh, answerEn, answerZhCn, order, isPublished, createdAt, updatedAt

API Routes (admin only, admin role required):
- GET /api/admin/faq/categories — all categories ordered
- POST /api/admin/faq/categories — create category
- PATCH /api/admin/faq/categories/[id] — update category
- DELETE /api/admin/faq/categories/[id] — delete category (cascade FAQs or block)
- GET /api/admin/faq — all FAQs (with category), paginated
- POST /api/admin/faq — create FAQ
- PATCH /api/admin/faq/[id] — update FAQ
- DELETE /api/admin/faq/[id] — delete FAQ

Public API (no auth):
- GET /api/faq — published FAQs grouped by category, for public page

⚠️ All API routes must validate with Zod and return 400 on invalid input. Admin routes must check session role === 'ADMIN'.
acceptance: Prisma migration creates FAQCategory and FAQ tables with all specified fields
GET /api/admin/faq/categories returns all categories ordered by `order`
POST/PATCH/DELETE admin category routes work with proper auth check
GET /api/admin/faq returns paginated FAQs with category relation
POST/PATCH/DELETE admin FAQ routes work with Zod validation
GET /api/faq returns published FAQs grouped by category (public, no auth)
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
files: src/app/api/faq/route.ts (new — public GET grouped by category)
verification: npx prisma migrate dev --name add_faq_models && npm run typecheck && curl GET /api/faq returns published FAQs grouped by category. Admin CRUD routes work with valid auth token.
